claims.evidence: MaxQuant experiments #1_LN_super-SILAC, #2_Lung_super-SILAC, #3_LN_super-SILAC (design template). Paper: "Lysates from three distinct metastatic tumors (LN1, Lung and LN2) were combined with the heavy standard". #1_LN=LN1 confirmed by deposited ratios: 18.8% of proteins with L/H<0.5 in #1_LN vs 8.6% (#2_Lung) and 9.3% (#3_LN), matching Fig. 2C (LN1 19%, Lung/LN2 8-9%); #3_LN=LN2 by elimination. Each experiment received its own aliquot of the reference, hence one reference source per mix.

Tumor lysates unlabelled; mqpar labelMods = ["", "Arg6;Lys6"], multiplicity 2. Deposited ERBB2 (NP_004439) H/L normalized = 0.022 in #2_Lung vs 1.55 (#1_LN) and 0.48 (#3_LN), i.e. ERBB2 strongly up in the light channel of the lung run, as the paper reports for the lung tumor.
Paper: 12 cell lines labelled with L-13C6-arginine (R6) and L-13C6-lysine (K6), pooled and spiked in as the standard; mqpar heavy labels Arg6;Lys6.
Patient tumor biopsies under study; PRIDE:0001013.
Heavy super-SILAC mix "used as a reference for the super-SILAC experiments"; PRIDE:0000899 (batch3 rule 18).
Human patient and human cell lines.
Table I: "Right cervical lymph node excision (5/2011)-LN1" and "Right cervical lymph node excision (11/2013)-LN2"; UBERON:0002429.
Table I: "Left lower lobe wedge resection of progressive lung metastasis (11/2011)-L"; UBERON:0008953.

claims.value: cervical lymph node / lower lobe of left lung
claims.evidence: Paper compares lung vs lymph node metastatic sites ("specific signaling networks were enriched in lung compared with the lymph node metastatic sites"). Mirrors characteristics[organism part]; heavy reference rows not applicable.

Each is one independent tumor; Lung is alone in its factor group (lower lobe of left lung), LN1 is the first sample in the cervical lymph node group. Paper: "There was not enough tissue left to conduct biological replicates."

LN2 (right cervical lymph node excised 11/2013) is a second, independent tumor in the same factor group as LN1 (excised 5/2011); the paper compares LN1 and LN2 directly (Fig. 2B, IPA LN1 vs LN2). Numbering restarts per factor-value group and must be unique per independent sample (spec README.adoc:330; batch3 rule 3; review round 1 finding 1).

limitations: SCOPE PARTIAL: the 24 TMT10plex runs (patient_TMT10plex_protein_F1-F12.raw, patient_TMT10plex_pST_F1-F12.raw) are NOT annotated. Only TMT126 = pool of all tumors and TMT128C = PDX are stated; the assignment of LN1, Lung, LN2 and MET1-5 to 127N, 127C, 128N, 129N, 129C, 130N, 130C, 131N is in no accessible source (paper text, deposited mqpar/parameters/proteinGroups which carry only "Reporter intensity 0-9"). Supplementary Tables S1-S5 (PMC bin/142441_1_supp_*.xlsx) were behind an NCBI proof-of-work bot check and the publisher site (mcponline.org) returned 403; Europe PMC says the article is not open access. The bioRxiv preprint 10.1101/398313 lists no supplementary files and its full-text PDF returned HTTP 429. Headers of patient_TMT10plex_protein_F1.raw and patient_TMT10plex_pST_F1.raw carry only paths and method names (top15HCD_90min_10uL_TMT_HCD40.meth), no channel names. Logged in BLOCKED.md (batch3 rule 7).

Supplementary Table S1 (super-SILAC) could not be read for the same reason; the light-sample identities were instead cross-checked against the deposited proteinGroups ratios (Fig. 2C percentages and ERBB2).

Non-RAW deposits are not runs and are not annotated: 23 MaxQuant search-output files (PRIDE category SEARCH) (mqpar/parameters/proteinGroups/peptides/PhosphoSTYSites/experimentalDesignTemplate), SupplementaryMRMresults_mutantpeptides.zip (the targeted MRM results behind PRIDE experimentType SRM/MRM; no MRM raw files are deposited), SupplementarypSTannotatedspectra.zip and Supplementary_snvs2_repor-high.zip (annotated variant-peptide spectra, PEAK).

characteristics[age] = not available on tumor rows: the paper gives only the age at diagnosis (50, 2008); the exact age at each excision (5/2011, 11/2011, 11/2013) is not published and was not derived.
characteristics[cell type] = not available on tumor rows (bulk tumor tissue, >=40% tumor cellularity; no cell type stated).

Conflicts resolved toward raw/search output: collision energy 32 NCE (raw) vs 40% (paper); precursor tolerance 4.5 ppm (mqpar) vs 7 ppm (paper); LC is EASY-nLC in the raw headers vs UltiMate 3000 in the paper (not encoded); deamidation listed in the paper but absent from the super-SILAC search (omitted).

Super-SILAC R1 (360 min, 2014) and R2 (80 min, 2015) injections differ in gradient; encoded as technical replicates 1 and 2 of the same fractionated sample, with the different run times in comment[chromatography duration]. The paper does not describe the duplicate injections.

Reference rows: the reference mix mixes immortalised normal lines and lung adenocarcinoma lines, so disease and organism part are not applicable; culture medium (RPMI 1640 with dialysed FBS) is not encoded because cell-lines is not declared.
